$comment: Architecture-phase acceptance definition. It records design and contract evidence without claiming implementation, runtime, deployment, or operational completion.

ownership.note: Registry ownership is observed. Cross-phase duplication and runtime ownership remain subject to Mission 0001 reconciliation.

areas.area: Architecture and phase contract are defined
areas.requirement: The phase has a canonical blueprint and machine-readable phase contract; this proves definition only.

areas.area: Implementation, runtime, deployment and operations remain unverified
areas.requirement: Executable modules, runtime consumers, deployment evidence and operational proof must be established by a later bounded mission; this definition does not infer them from design text.
